Instead of selling the property, you take out a new loan (or top-up an existing mortgage) secured against the property’s value and receive the difference in cash. This cash can be used for any purpose, including funding your business operations, expansion, or investment.

description: Property Cashout page sections, in the order they appear: hero, what property cashout is, the comparison against standard refinancing, how it works, eligible property types, the key benefits, the eligibility requirements, why Think SME, the FAQ and the final CTA. This page has no pricing table, no free tools and no Google Reviews slider — its design draws none. The faq_* and cta_* field names repeat the other pages’ names under different keys, which is what lets template-parts/faq.php and cta.php stay page-agnostic; unlike every other page, the FAQ questions here are fields rather than the site-wide “FAQs” posts. Everything is flat fields because ACF free has no Repeater — quantities are fixed by the layout, and empty entries are skipped rather than rendered blank. Leave a field empty to keep the design’s own copy — the theme treats an empty value as "use the default", so clearing this brings the design text back rather than removing it.
